title: What became of Curtis Amy
summary: Curtis Amy died a few years earlier and could have thrived on the chitlin' circuit.

story.theme_name: Illness, injury and the deaths of colleagues
story.community_name: Illness, injury and death among jazz musicians

blocks.x: Curtis passed away maybe four or five years ago. Just almost made it into that Fathead [David Newman] style, almost, because that’s where he was coming from. He almost got into that Fathead. He could do it, but he just – it was just a hard thing to cross over and get into. He would have done good if he could have got to the East Coast and started playing the chitlin’ circuit, because that chitlin’ circuit made a lot of tenor players, especially with an organ. You come through, a tenor player with an organ, boy, them chitlin’ circuit, you got . . .
